sec.title: September 4 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 743)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 4** across Jack Webb starring as hardboiled private eye Jeff Regan in *The House by the Sea*, Jean Arthur and Fred MacMurray in Somerset Maugham's matrimonial farce *Too Many Husbands* on *The Screen Guild Theater* for Lady Esther, Bill Forman narrating railroad track-switching sabotage on *The Whistler* for Signal Oil, Herbert Marshall in isolated jungle outpost drama on *Hollywood Star Playhouse*, Matt Crowley foiling international munitions cartels on *The Adventures of Dick Tracy*, and Marvin Miller's solo short story performances on *Armchair Adventures*, Jack Webb (1948), Jean Arthur & Fred MacMurray (1944), Bill Forman (1946), Herbert Marshall (1950), Matt Crowley (1944), and Marvin Miller (1944–1952):
